portableImprovements.rule: Bind every material claim to evidence and timed visuals, and preserve explicit non-claims.
English-copy and semantic-correlation reviews name a reviewer and bind the reviewed revision by SHA-256.
Require a deliberately designed ten-second final view with start, quarter, midpoint, and end timing probes; do not promote silent-outro acceptance.
Combine full decode, stream parity, loudness, subtitle, safe-area, ASR, OCR, and checksum evidence without claiming that the reference image bundles every model.
A gate is incomplete unless representative invalid fixtures fail for the expected reason.

evidenceBoundary.note: Only public-safe process rules and source digests are carried forward; run media and internal evidence remain outside this reference.
